claims.statement: make setup performs first-time setup (start infra, recreate DB, migrate, seed) and make dev starts db+redis+backend+frontend; make migrate backs up the database first and fails closed.
Root package.json maps dev to make dev; backend runs on 3001 and frontend on 7174 strictPort with Postgres 5441, Redis 6391, Adminer 8083.
Test accounts resolve per environment via testplan/testaccounts.txt with shared staging password Abc123; demo mode is permanently disabled.
